     1	import dlt
     2	from pyspark.sql.functions import col, trim
     3	from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
     4	
     5	spark = SparkSession.getActiveSession()
     6	catalog = spark.conf.get("catalog")
     7	target_schema = spark.conf.get("target_schema")  # silver target schema, e.g., distributor_silver
     8	# Derive bronze schema from silver target
     9	bronze_schema = target_schema.replace("_silver", "_bronze")
    10	bronze_table = f"{catalog}.{bronze_schema}.distributor_mv"
    11	
    12	@dlt.expect_or_drop("valid_distributor_id", "distributor_id IS NOT NULL")
    13	@dlt.table(
    14	    name="distributor_mv",
    15	    comment="Silver distributor view with cleaned data",
    16	    table_properties={"quality": "silver"},
    17	    schema="""
    18	        distributor_id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    19	        distributor_name STRING,
    20	        phone_number STRING,
    21	        street_address STRING,
    22	        postal_code STRING,
    23	        city STRING,
    24	        state STRING,
    25	        country STRING
    26	    """
    27	)
    28	def distributor_mv():
    29	    # Read from bronze table as a batch source
    30	    df = spark.read.table(bronze_table)
    31	    # Trim whitespace from string columns
    32	    string_cols = ["distributor_name", "phone_number", "street_address", "postal_code", "city", "state", "country"]
    33	    for c in string_cols:
    34	        df = df.withColumn(c, trim(col(c)))
    35	    return df
